{{Quote|Brand-new species, not in any of our files. He's been pretty blustery, but we've managed to pry the location of his home system out of him, and we're putting together a task force to head over there and make contact.|Jorm Whistler Mackenni|<ref name="FB" />}}
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''', with a body shape that could be confused with that of an [[Eickarie]] or a [[Lakra]]'s, originated in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The [[Empire of the Hand]]<ref name="FB" /> an Imperial successor polity, which had not encountered the species,<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> determined that the individual who ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kariek]] for fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] known as [[the Warlord]] was a member of the [[Species/Legends|species]] instead of an Eickarie or Lakra after the Hand [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Unit Aurek-Seven]] [[Capture of the Warlord|captured]] him on the Kariek, the Eickarie [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="FB" /> by [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].<ref name="22ABY">''[[Fool's Bargain]]'' is set before the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> The Hand also learnt of the species' point of origin from him and subsequently prepared to send a [[Task force/Legends|task force]] to contact the species. Shortly after, [[Aurek/Legends|Aurek]]-Seven [[Jorm Whistler Mackenni]] informed the [[Eickarie]] [[Su-mil]] of their discovery and plans to establish contact with the Warlord's kind, and theorized that the Eckarie ruling body of the [[InterTribal Council]] would like to have Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] over Kariek in case that the Warlord's species attempted to attack the planet.<ref name="FB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species appeared in the [[2004]] novella ''[[Fool's Bargain]]''.<ref name="FB" />
